what_this_is: Tools the tray offers (src/workspace/tray-screen.tsx offers every tool whose input takes `things`). tool:tell-trillions-makers hands what a person picked, their note, the screen, a picture and their browser to the account its invoke names (src/hand-to-an-account.mjs), as a row of that account's list and a notice. Another place to send a tray to is another row here. Its screen (group tell-us) is also a row of the Tell us list above Start, where a member reports a bug, sends feedback or shares an idea; what it is (kind) lands in the list's What it is field, and each note is handed to the operator account's AIs (invoke.hand_off).

payload.label: Tell the people who make Trillion
payload.job: Tell the people who make Trillion about anything: report a bug, send feedback, or share an idea, with the things picked in Trillion
payload.description: Takes kind (a bug report, friction, feedback or an idea), things (what the person picked in their tray: each { kind, label, screen_label?, place?, address?, id? }, place being the space it was picked in), note (their own words), where (their own work or the space they were working in), screen (the address they were on), browser and picture (the identity of a picture of the screen in their Files). Sends it all to the people who make Trillion, who read every one.

kind.description: What the note is: a bug report (something went wrong), friction (something was hard to do), feedback (something to change) or an idea

picture.description: A picture of the screen, from your Files

where.description: Where you were working: your own Trillion or the pursuit's name

list.label: Notes from members
list.about: Member reports and their linked work orders. Report delivery is separate from the work result and later outcome evidence; real, synthetic and unknown origins remain visible.

invoke.said: Sent to the people who make Trillion. Thank you.

hand_off.job: A member told the people who make Trillion something ({kind}; sent by {sent_by}). Read row {row} of the list Notes from members and act on it: for a bug report or friction, find the cause and fix it; for feedback or an idea, decide whether and how to build it. Their words: {note} Keep the canonical source record {source_ref} linked to the work, retain the actual execution and proof references, and distinguish an implemented or deployed change from an independently observed member outcome. A synthetic report is a test fixture, not member testimony.

provenance.source: src/hand-to-an-account.mjs with the tray in src/workspace/tray-screen.tsx

screen.label: Report a bug or share an idea
screen.about: Tell the people who make Trillion what went wrong, what to change, or an idea. We read every one.
